youtube.title: Why Stop Signs Are Octagons 🛑 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Stop signs have 8 sides on purpose. 🛑

In 1923, US highway engineers ranked shapes by danger: the more sides, the more dangerous. And the first stop signs were yellow, not red.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
